summary: Treasury's doubling of long-term bond buybacks sent yields lower and sparked a broad short squeeze across crypto, with Bitcoin surging past $72,000. Soft jobs and inflation prints this week cut September Fed hike odds to roughly 31%, pulling the dollar lower and amplifying gold's rally to multi-month highs.
tweet: Treasury doubled bond buybacks, soft jobs and CPI data slashed Fed hike odds to 31%, and a crypto short squeeze sent Bitcoin past $72K — risk assets and gold are both bid at once.
